# Eire Reborn - Irish activity pulse actions. Generated by tools/gen_activities.py

eir_oenach_lawsuit = {
	icon = positive
	is_valid = {
		is_current_phase_active = yes
		any_attending_character = {
			location = scope:province
			this != scope:host
			is_adult = yes
		}
	}

	weight = {
		value = 1.2
		if = {
			limit = {
				scope:activity = {
					has_activity_option = {
						category = eir_oenach_focus
						option = eir_oenach_focus_law
					}
				}
			}
			multiply = 1.5
		}
	}

	effect = {
		scope:host = {
			save_scope_as = root_scope
		}
		random_attending_character = {
			limit = {
				location = scope:province
				this != scope:host
			is_adult = yes
			}
			save_scope_as = first
		}
		add_activity_log_entry = {
			key = eir_oenach_lawsuit
			tags = { pulse_action }
			character = scope:first
			scope:first = {
				add_prestige = minor_prestige_gain
				add_stress = minor_stress_loss
			}
		}
	}
}

eir_feis_harp = {
	icon = positive
	is_valid = {
		is_current_phase_active = yes
		any_attending_character = {
			location = scope:province
			this != scope:host
			is_adult = yes
			learning >= 6
		}
	}

	weight = {
		value = 0.8
	}

	effect = {
		scope:host = {
			save_scope_as = root_scope
		}
		random_attending_character = {
			limit = {
				location = scope:province
				this != scope:host
			is_adult = yes
			learning >= 6
			}
			save_scope_as = first
		}
		add_activity_log_entry = {
			key = eir_feis_harp
			tags = { pulse_action }
			character = scope:first
			scope:first = {
				add_prestige = minor_prestige_gain
				add_trait_xp = { trait = lifestyle_poet value = 15 }
			}
		}
	}
}

eir_feis_snub = {
	icon = negative
	is_valid = {
		is_current_phase_active = yes
		any_attending_character = {
			location = scope:province
			this != scope:host
			is_adult = yes
			is_ai = yes
			has_trait = arrogant
		}
	}

	weight = {
		value = 1.0
		if = {
			limit = {
				scope:activity = {
					has_activity_option = {
						category = eir_feis_focus
						option = eir_feis_focus_favour
					}
				}
			}
			multiply = 1.5
		}
	}

	effect = {
		scope:host = {
			save_scope_as = root_scope
		}
		random_attending_character = {
			limit = {
				location = scope:province
				this != scope:host
			is_adult = yes
			is_ai = yes
			has_trait = arrogant
			}
			save_scope_as = first
		}
		add_activity_log_entry = {
			key = eir_feis_snub
			tags = { pulse_action }
			character = scope:first
			scope:first = {
				add_prestige = minor_prestige_loss
				add_opinion = { target = scope:host modifier = eir_act_insulted_opinion opinion = -10 }
			}
		}
	}
}

			this != scope:host
			is_adult = yes
			is_ai = yes
		}
	}

	weight = {
		value = 0.8
		if = {
			limit = {
				scope:activity = {
					has_activity_option = {
						category = eir_hosting_focus
						option = eir_hosting_focus_muster
					}
				}
			}
			multiply = 1.4
		}
	}

	effect = {
		scope:host = {
			save_scope_as = root_scope
		}
		random_attending_character = {
			limit = {
				location = scope:province
				this != scope:host
			is_adult = yes
			is_ai = yes
			}
			save_scope_as = first
		}
		add_activity_log_entry = {
			key = eir_hosting_hunger
			tags = { pulse_action }
			character = scope:first
			scope:first = {
				add_stress = minor_stress_gain
				remove_short_term_gold = minor_gold_value
			}
		}
	}
}

eir_bardic_satire = {
	icon = negative
	is_valid = {
		is_current_phase_active = yes
		any_attending_character = {
			location = scope:province
			this != scope:host
			is_adult = yes
			is_ai = yes
			NOT = { has_trait = humble }
		}
	}

	weight = {
		value = 1.0
		if = {
			limit = {
				scope:activity = {
					has_activity_option = {
						category = eir_bardic_focus
						option = eir_bardic_focus_satire
					}
				}
			}
			multiply = 1.8
		}
	}

	effect = {
		scope:host = {
			save_scope_as = root_scope
		}
		random_attending_character = {
			limit = {
				location = scope:province
				this != scope:host
			is_adult = yes
			is_ai = yes
			NOT = { has_trait = humble }
			}
			save_scope_as = first
		}
		add_activity_log_entry = {
			key = eir_bardic_satire
			tags = { pulse_action }
			character = scope:first
			scope:first = {
				add_prestige = minor_prestige_loss
				add_stress = minor_stress_gain
				add_opinion = { target = scope:host modifier = eir_act_insulted_opinion opinion = -10 }
			}
		}
	}
}
